commentary: Indian benchmark indices snapped a six-week losing streak on crude relief, but Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil teach us never to confuse an index bounce with true market breadth. With the breadth score at 49 and clear divergence—Nifty Midcap sliding 0.29% while smallcaps lag—institutional capital remains strictly selective. Under our deterministic CAUTION gate, progressive exposure must be respected. We do not chase extended moves, and CANSLIM discipline dictates that breakout candidates lacking verified, accelerating earnings cannot be treated as market leaders. Capital preservation is paramount; we focus only on verified Stage 2 leaders breaking out on heavy volume while enforcing tight stop discipline on all positions.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price trades above 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA near its 20-session pivot at 103.06 on 1.21x volume. However, overhead resistance is heavy, and relative strength is sluggish compared to primary market leaders, showing inadequate base consolidation quality.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe fundamental deterioration. Standalone Q1 FY27 revenue collapsed 56.3% YoY to Rs 44.6 crore, while net profit dropped 25.4% YoY to Rs 1.0 crore. Weak ROE (3.1%), poor interest coverage, and declining promoter holdings fail CANSLIM standards entirely.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Failure occurs below the 94.11 swing stop. Cut losses immediately; deteriorating sales and margins eliminate fundamental backing.

ABBOTINDIA.technical: Stage 2 advance confirmed as price punches through a 20-session breakout pivot at 28,968.94 on massive institutional volume of 5.07x average. RSI of 63 supports unextended momentum, holding cleanly above upward-trending 21 EMA and 50 SMA.
ABBOTINDIA.fundamental: High-quality MNC defensive with stellar ROCE (44.8%), zero net debt, and operating margins at 28.8%. However, Q1 FY27 revenue grew just 4.3% YoY and net profit gained 17.1% YoY, missing CANSLIM's aggressive 25%/15% growth thresholds.
ABBOTINDIA.risk: Violation of 27,801.08 stop invalidates the breakout. Trim exposure immediately on any high-volume close below the 50 SMA.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Forming a constructive double-bottom reversal with neckline pressure at 431.13. Trading cleanly above the 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA on 1.77x volume. RSI at 52 confirms momentum accumulation without extension, poised for continuation.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Strong operational momentum across financial services. Q1 FY27 revenue expanded 28.2% YoY to Rs 12,179 crore, while consolidated PAT climbed 43.3% YoY to Rs 1,224 crore. Margins expanded across NBFC and credit units, backed by 68.8% promoter ownership.
ABCAPITAL.risk: Stop sits at 410.13. Thesis fails if price breaks below the dual swing lows on expanding distribution volume.

ABSLLIQUID.technical: Instrument tracks overnight cash rates near 1,006. While technically registering above moving averages due to incremental yield accrual, it is an overnight cash ETF rather than an equity breakout pattern. Relative strength is flat by definition.
ABSLLIQUID.risk: Not an equity instrument. Holding carries opportunity cost and zero upside participation relative to equities.

ACE.technical: Clear SEPA Stage 2 advance punching to new 52-week highs at 1,214.41 on 2.87x volume. Price sits comfortably above rising 21, 50, and 200 SMAs, exhibiting strong institutional accumulation, though approaching minor short-term extension.
ACE.fundamental: Dominant industrial player with 63% crane market share, near debt-free balance sheet, and 31.6% ROCE. However, Q1 FY27 net profit growth decelerated to 22.3% YoY on 18.9% revenue growth, capping setup status per CANSLIM C+A rules.
ACE.risk: Stop at 1,123.57. Exit swiftly if price drops below 21 EMA support on heavy institutional selling.

ACMESOLAR.technical: Textbook SEPA Stage 2 breakout to new trailing-year highs clearing 430.93 on explosive 4.89x volume. Superior relative strength versus broader indices, supported by an orderly base structure and stacked, upward-trending 21, 50, and 200 SMAs.
ACMESOLAR.fundamental: Elite CANSLIM growth profile. Q1 FY27 net profit surged 79.9% YoY to Rs 235 crore on 63.3% revenue growth to Rs 954 crore, driven by massive BESS capacity ramp-up and high 86% generation EBITDA margins.
ACMESOLAR.risk: Strict stop at 394.55. Exit immediately if high-volume distribution undercuts the pivot or project execution stumbles.
